_comment: Section gates for the Top 25 dashboard. A section is LIVE only when BOTH hold: (1) its data 'requires' are all met by polls_games_dashboard.csv, and (2) 'published' is true. Data-ready but unpublished sections stay greyed out so nothing goes public without approval. Evaluate with scripts/process/evaluate_section_gates.py (writes dashboard_gates.json beside the data).

_metrics.polls_released: Distinct poll weeks in the file (Pre counts).
_metrics.complete_weeks: Poll weeks whose games window has closed (every poll week except the newest).
_metrics.upsets: Unique games flagged Upset or Major Upset.
_metrics.top25_matchups: Unique games where both teams were ranked.
_metrics.min_games_per_team: Fewest games played by any team.
_metrics.pct_teams_games_ge2: Share of teams with at least 2 games.
_metrics.pct_teams_games_ge3: Share of teams with at least 3 games.
_metrics.pct_teams_home_ge2: Share of teams with at least 2 home games.
_metrics.pct_teams_road_ge2: Share of teams with at least 2 road games.
_metrics.pct_teams_conf_ge2: Share of teams with at least 2 conference games.
_metrics.pct_teams_top25_ge2: Share of teams with at least 2 games against ranked opponents.
